scenes.say: October is done. November the first was the turn.
On Friday, we listened to every one of you. Now we mean it.
Here is your day, from both sides. Eight o'clock: your goal, your fact finds, your clients. And our team is already chasing your cases.
By half past ten, you check in, and you are present. Not checked in? We call, to understand.
At noon, tell us how it's going. Need help? Your manager hears it, straight away.
At half past five, you close off. What you planned, and what you did. We see it too.
You see us. We see you. Everyone is accountable.
Every reminder runs on a template. Yours: morning, midday, close-off, and a star for every case we close. Your clients hear from us too.
And they answer. Seventeen hundred and eighty-one clients, written to. Six hundred and sixty-five, answered. Two hundred and sixty-two asked us to call. That is the big win.

Your fact finds have a journey too. The plan goes to your client the same day. A reminder on day three, another on day eight, then we ask you to call. Half of all confirmations came after a reminder, and every rating since October is five stars.
No more guessing. The system shows us where every one of us stands. Then we coach in person. A call, a visit, a sit-down, with the facts in hand.
Rajiv went first. His updates on the record. Seven applications in October.
That is the level. Every one of us, there.
To every one of you who stayed the course: thank you. You built this with us, and now we reap it, together.
Check in. Lift each other. Rise.
